question: Where is gallery situated within 90 kilometers along the travel path toward All Saints Way, Boston, MA from Cyrus Dallin Art Museum, Arlington, MA?
sql: WITH start_loc AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cyrus Dallin Art Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Arlington%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_loc_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%All Saints Way%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Boston%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_loc_road AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS geometry FROM roads WHERE road_name ILIKE '%All Saints Way%' LIMIT 1 ), target_end_point AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT geometry FROM end_loc_poi) IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT geometry FROM end_loc_poi) ELSE (SELECT geometry FROM end_loc_road) END AS geometry ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, start_loc AS sl, target_end_point AS tep WHERE p.tourism = 'gallery' AND sl.geometry IS NOT NULL AND tep.geometry IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sl.geometry::geography, 90000) AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(sl.geometry, tep.geometry)::geography, 500)) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sl.geometry::geography) ASC;
